note: Synthetic long threads for the observe job eval. Turns alternate owner and kos. The note must stand in for the older exchanges, mention what mattered, and not soften a failure.

cases.name: a planning thread keeps its decisions
turns: Let's plan the pantry app. I want barcode scanning first, then expiry alerts. It has to run on the Raspberry Pi in the kitchen.
Understood. Barcode scanning first, then expiry alerts, on the Pi. I will use SQLite rather than Postgres so it runs there.
Good. Use the ZXing library for scanning, it worked on my old project.
ZXing it is. I have created projects/pantry and the first migration for an items table.
Also, never store product photos, just the barcode and a name.
Noted: no photos, barcode and name only.
What is left before I can try it?
The scanner screen and the expiry job. I will do the scanner next.
Starting on the scanner screen now.
The scanner screen renders; the camera permission prompt is wired.
